focusedAudit.reason: 0.8.0 is Tine Beta 0.8.0-beta.12 plus the GH #771 macOS owner-connection fix (D-20261026-771) (tested by Beta users since 2026-10-24, the 0.8 line since 2026-10-13), plus version metadata and the website files stable already served. Martin authorized the cut on 2026-10-26 (D-20261026-CUT) on the basis that the reports since beta.10 are of decreasing severity; no exact-tree release audit was run, which is a deferral, not an audit certification.

items.text: Stable Tine now carries the 0.8 Beta line. Beta keeps its separate app and update channel, and continues with the next development line.

regressionEvidence.reason: No code change beyond 0.8.0-beta.12: every behaviour change is listed, with its catalog row, in that Beta's sections and impact files.
